cases.name: Katie Bishop
cases.about:
“Katie was so full of life. Making friends came easy for her. She loved her cats, even had a pet rat. This comes as a terrible shock that anyone could do such an awful thing to such a sweet young woman. This is hard on her dad as she was an only child. We’re all in shock. It’s just going to take a long time to get over this. She was loved by her family and friends.”

SHIRLEY ORANGE, BISHOP’S AUNT
cases.narrative: Police found her body was in a closet at the apartment they shared.
